Minesweeper: Word Hunt

A fun new twist on classic Minesweeper! Each flag could reveal a dangerous mine, or a crucial hint. Explore over a thousand puzzles across 10 fun categories - from Movies & TV to Countries, Animals, and more.

Features

A New Twist

Once you've played Minesweeper with puzzles, you'll never want to go back!

Over 1,000 Puzzles

With over a thousand puzzles across ten fun categories, the fun never ends!

Solve Quickly for High Scores

Minesweeper: Word Hunt lets you solve puzzles quickly for higher scores! Solve the puzzle with less than 1/3 of the mines flagged to achieve a perfect score.

FAQ

Do I need an internet connection to play?

No, you don't need an internet connection to play. However, If you haven't purchased ad-free access, you may experience some lag or limited functionality without an internet connection.

How often are new puzzles added?

New puzzles are added frequently. We aim to release new puzzles every week.

Can I turn off sounds or music?

Yes, you can turn off sounds and music in the settings. Tap the settings button on the home screen.
